description: Free-text search over every route in the World Train Map atlas — matches route name, cities, train name, operator and countries, with optional category/country filters. Accent-insensitive; every word of the query must match. Returns compact per-route facts with id and worldtrainmap.com URL, sorted by renown with route-name matches first; with no query it lists the whole atlas by renown. Use get_route with a returned id for full detail, famous_routes for a ready-made top list, city_pair for A-to-B journey times.

country.description: Only routes crossing this country — full name or 2-letter ISO code ("Switzerland" or "CH").

query.description: Free text matched against name, cities, train, operator and countries — e.g. "glacier", "Tokyo", "Amtrak". Omit to browse all routes by renown.

name: search_routes
title: Search train routes
